doc.description:
Fixed-wing automatic launch detection
When this module is used, the pitch angle of plane is monitored, if the angle goes over a specified value (nose up) for 2 seconds it will trigger the launch variable. This is useful for handlaunch when one has no GCS or remote control at hand, or simply to avoid the risk of forgetting to switch to Auto mode before throwing the plane.
The launch variable can be reset to FALSE by pointing the nose to the ground a user specified amount of time. This is useful to abort the launch in case of not wanting to launch anymore.
The module can be configured to also work in AUTO1, which is useful for handlaunch when no autonomy flight is tested. The module disables itself within a few seconds, per default 4s, after detecting the launch. It can be re-activated by hand from the GCS.

define.name: TAKEOFF_DETECT_LAUNCH_PITCH
define.description: Picth angle for takeoff detection (set 'launch' to TRUE)

define.name: TAKEOFF_DETECT_ABORT_PITCH
define.description: Pitch angle to abort takeoff (set 'launch' to FALSE)

define.name: TAKEOFF_DETECT_TIMER
define.description: Timer for takeoff detection in seconds (default 2s above pitch angle threshold)

define.name: TAKEOFF_DETECT_DISABLE_TIMER
define.description: Timer for module de-activation (default 4s after the launch detection)
